brief:
Data journalist Mona Chalabi, who won the Pulitzer Prize, spoke with Zeteo about her decision to publicly support Palestine despite professional risks. Chalabi discussed her new book alongside broader themes of rising wealth inequality and economic populism in the United States.

The conversation touched on Chalabi's willingness to jeopardize her career to advocate for Gaza, reflecting tensions between journalistic neutrality and personal conviction on the conflict.
dek: Mehdi sits down with Mona Chalabi to talk about her new book, the rise of wealth inequality and economic populism in the U.S., and why she risked her livelihood to speak out for Palestine.
title: Pulitzer winner Chalabi discusses Gaza advocacy and wealth inequality
